meta.name: Dinastías
meta.description: Follow the true stories of five of the world's most celebrated, yet endangered animals; penguins, chimpanzees, lions, painted wolves and tigers. Each in a heroic struggle against rivals and against the forces of nature, these families fight for their own survival and for the future of their dynasties.
meta.country: China, France, United Kingdom, United States of America

videos.title: Chimpanzee
videos.overview: A chimpanzee leader is surrounded by rivals who are prepared to kill him for his crown. Can he hold on to power? A story of power, politics and the fight for survival.

videos.title: Emperor
videos.overview: Emperor penguins battle for survival against the worst winter in the world. Working together can they protect and feed their chicks till they reach adulthood?

videos.title: Lion
videos.overview: The leader of a once mighty lion pride must now battle for their very survival. Can this extraordinary lioness save her family from disaster?

videos.title: Painted Wolf
videos.overview: The leader of a great Painted Wolf family is growing old. Her power to keep the peace is waning. A feud with an ambitious daughter threatens to bring the dynasty down.

videos.title: Tiger
videos.overview: A tigress, Raj Bhera, has 4 new cubs. She must protect them while battling rivals who want to steal her lands and overthrow her. Will she hold on and raise her cubs to adulthood?

videos.title: Puma
videos.overview: A mother puma must battle rivals, tackle prey nearly three times her size and endure the wild mountain weather of Patagonia in her bid to raise four cubs – her biggest litter yet.

videos.title: Elephant
videos.overview: In Amboseli, Kenya, an incredibly rare event pushes a struggling elephant family to its limits. To save their dynasty, they have to work together and overcome the challenge of a lifetime.

videos.title: Cheetah
videos.overview: On Zambia’s plains, a cheetah mother must keep her precious cubs safe, preparing them for life without her. They take on dangerous prey, battle hyenas and learn that even tiny neighbours can bite back.

videos.title: Hyena
videos.overview: With the emergence of a young rival, a spotted hyena queen struggles to keep her grip on power – while also trying to raise a family – on Zambia’s vast and unforgiving Liuwa Plain grasslands.

videos.title: The Prequel
videos.overview: An exclusive first view of David Attenborough's new series, Dynasties. Five extraordinary animals, battling rivals and the forces of nature for the future of their families.

videos.title: David Attenborough On Dynasties
videos.overview: Sir David Attenborough reveals what convinced him to do Dynasties, the state of the planet and having an homonymous chimp.

videos.title: The Dynasties Playlists: Kingdoms, by Phil Taggart
videos.overview: A journey across the animal kingdoms of BBC One's Dynasties, set to a chillout soundtrack by the host of Radio 1's Chillest Show, Phil Taggart.

videos.title: The Dynasties Playlists: Fire and Rain, by Daniel P Carter
videos.overview: Venture deep into the wild forest fires and rainstorms of Senegal, to a soundtrack by Radio 1 Rock Show presenter Daniel P Carter.

videos.title: The Making of Dynasties
videos.overview: Four years in the making and over a thousand days in the field, the Dynasties team set out to film the stories of five extraordinary animals. Embarking on their missions, the film crews traveled from the plains of Africa to the jungles of India.

videos.title: Meerkat: A Dynasties Special
videos.overview: A film following a young meerkat queen living in the harsh beauty of the Makgadikgadi salt pans. If her new pups are to survive, she must unite her family in the face of rivals, predators and immense dust storms.

videos.title: The Making of Dynasties: Season 2
videos.overview: Behind the scenes footage of how Season 2 of this breathtaking series was filmed.

videos.title: Macaque: Monkeys in the Mountains – A Dynasties Special
videos.overview: High in the Atlas Mountains of Morocco lives a group of Barbary macaque monkeys. The alpha male, known as Mac, has just battled to win the leadership of the troop. He must now lead and protect them while fending off rivals who still want his crown.
